c74object.name: evi_biquads_filters
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_biquads_filters.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_biquads_filters.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
A collection of different biquad filters for use with the evieve biquad coefficient calculators or other calculations. Usage, e.g.: 'out1 = biquadDf2(in1, eviBiquadCoeffLowpassGain(cutoffHz, linearGain, Q))'.

entry.name: biquadDf1 ( )
entry.description:
'Direct Form 1', like MSP [biquad~], do not use this
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a0, a0 coefficient
In 3: type=input: a1, a1 coefficient
In 4: type=input: a2, a2 coefficient
In 5: type=input: b1, b1 coefficient
In 6: type=input: b2, b2 coefficient
Return 1: Filter, Filtered audio output
